title: Run context
description: Stage 1 run-context artifact (01-run-context.json). Captures the resolved operation, adapters, languages, revisions, editorial path, and safety gates for a content-generation run.

language.description: One of the five supported sample languages.

approvedEquivalentGate.description: Configuration for the approved-equivalent editorial gate. ALL fields are required when editorialPath is approved-equivalent.

gateName.description: Immutable name of the approved editorial gate.

gateVersion.description: Immutable version of the approved editorial gate.

policyName.description: Immutable name of the editorial policy applied by the gate.

policyVersion.description: Immutable version of the editorial policy.

approvalIdentity.description: Identity that approved this gate for use.

approvalLocator.description: Immutable locator (URL or path) to the approval record.

invocationMechanism.description: How the gate is invoked (executable path, import, or API).

artifactRoot.description: Absolute path to the repository-local artifact root for this gate, must end with 10-equivalent-gate.

runId.description: Unique run identifier (timestamp plus source revision).

generatedUtc.description: UTC timestamp when this run context was generated.

operation.description: The operation mode for this run.

baseAdapter.description: Identifier of the base adapter (e.g. cosmos-nosql-vector).

extensionAdapter.description: Identifier of the baseline extension adapter (e.g. create-index), or null if none.

repositoryRoot.description: Absolute path to the sample repository root.

skillRoot.description: Absolute path to this skill's root directory.

outputRoot.description: Absolute path to the run-scoped output directory.

sampleRevision.description: Immutable commit SHA of the sample source pinned for this run.

target.description: The target articles or revision to audit, create, or update.

paths.description: Local file paths when kind is local-paths.

prUrl.description: Pull request URL when kind is pr-url.

targetRevision.description: Target base revision SHA when kind is base-revision.

editorialPath.description: Selected editorial quality path for this run.

mosaicConfig.description: Mosaic writer configuration when editorialPath is mosaic, null otherwise.

approvedEquivalentGate.description: Approved-equivalent gate configuration, required when editorialPath is approved-equivalent.

dryRun.description: When true, no external writes are performed.

present.description: Whether an external write approval is present.

approvalLocator.description: Locator for the write approval record, empty when not present.

azureOperationsAllowed.description: Azure operations are never allowed during content generation.
